answer: Yes, we buy cars with open safety recalls, and an open recall doesn't change your offer; you can have it repaired free at a dealer for your car's brand first, but you don't have to. Any hail damage you know about should be listed on the damage disclosure form, NW-DMG-1, before the inspection, and damage you list there is already priced into your offer and won't lower it again. The help center doesn't cover whether we buy cars with an open insurance claim, so please contact a store about that part.
